name: Katashina (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Katashina village emblem in white, green and yellow: two outlined squares with yellow strokes above green stylised characters.
history: Municipal flag of Katashina, a village in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1989.

features.role: Katashina village emblem — two outlined squares with yellow strokes above green stylised characters
